notes_for_editor: Thin on primary records: the Lighthouse Board reports for 1902-1909 are not in the corpus, so the appropriation, design and construction come from NPS pages and Lighthousefriends (a secondary source, own words only). Disagreements stated in the text: first lighting 1 vs 9 Sept 1909; tower 132 vs 138 ft; appropriation 1908 (NPS) vs about 1907 (Lighthousefriends implies); NRHP says Robins served ten years, USLHS gives 1940-1953; lens removal 'early 1980s' (NPS caption) vs January 1985 (LF). LF dates John Souza's fatal fall 'December 2008', surely 1908; unverified, one source. The 1938 Bulletin earthquake and LF's 22 Jan 1938 date are matched by content only. USLHS says Open to Public: Yes; LF and NPS say closed/permit only. Not found: Hawaiian newspapers (Chronicling America search for Keanu timed out). Bulletin OCR is column-interleaved, so only clean sentences were quoted. Keepers' dwellings: LF says three; NRHP lists 1913 and 1950 dwellings. Range: NRHP gives 25 nm in one place, '28 miles' in another, NPS 21 miles; not stated in facts.
